title: Wren and the Letters
author: Silas Pemberton
blurb: Sebastian Iversen, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
